_doc: Lead-proven dead reads: globals the original reads only to set flags that every path then overwrites with identical effects (e.g. cmp byte [g],K / je to a block identical to the fallthrough). A compiler deletes such loads, so the shape gate ignores these globals for the named function. Each entry needs evidence. 'callees': calls that sit only on lead-proven dead paths (blocks also listed in specs/coverage_exempt.json).

0x00555e93.evidence: 'cmp byte [0x86857c],K; je' selects between two blocks that are both 'add esi,0x18; ret' (the add overwrites the cmp flags), so the byte's value never affects any output.

0x0053ddbb.evidence: 0x54e232 (debug print) is called only at 0x53de5a, reached only from switch case 4 (0x53de3a); the index is byte [ebx+0xd] & 3 (0..3), so 'cmp eax,5; jb' always skips the 'mov eax,4' block 0x0053de03 and case 4 never runs (coverage_exempt lists the block; L27 proof, lead check).

0x00551f83.evidence: Bytes 66 9c 50 .. 58 66 9d c3: pushfw/push eax, a cmp/jne chain over these four globals, pop eax/popfw/ret. The pops restore eax and the low 16 EFLAGS bits (CF/PF/AF/ZF/SF/OF), nothing is stored, so the reads never affect any output.
